title: Perform inventory ratio analysis and interpretation

items.concept: Period-end adjusting journal entry under the periodic system that establishes ending inventory and residual COGS; initial recognition of purchases/freight; AP settlement and sales; multi-year inventory turnover, days in inventory, and gross profit % with interpretation
Number-variant twin of periodic purchase recognition, settlements, period-end COGS adjusting JE, inventory bridge, and multi-year inventory ratio analysis
Period-end LIFO conversion adjusting JE; subsequent measurement ratio schedule under LIFO vs FIFO (LIFO reserve restatement); method effects when prices rise; peer comparison after adjustment
Classification of cost-flow method effects on inventory turnover when acquisition costs are rising
Correct computation of inventory turnover and average days in inventory
